source_evidence: Exact player 'Follow them' authorizes pursuit of the four departing requisition soldiers, not combat, surrender of credentials, entering their camp, or new expenditure. D356~10:26–10:30 Mara voluntarily agrees to remain at the rescued waystation with V's coach/four healthy horses, proprietor willingly offers temporary shelter/yard access for the investigation without fee; no paid lodging, hire, permanent custody transfer, or guaranteed safety. V/Cirren/Fenar follow the eastward tracks on foot, maintaining distance and not calling out. Fenar leads tracking on six-mile established camp trail; predeclared Wisdom(Survival)+5 DC12 (failure would cost one hour recovering trail), genuine Python secrets receipt batch c3a1da60ea26f42e8ea1e153be4bba6b d20 face16+5=21 succeeds. No Help, Guidance, Psi, or other feature used. Travel at ordinary difficult trail pace ~1.5mph, no forced march; four soldiers return to their actual forward camp around14:16 after leaving10:16, V/C/F reach wooded rise outside camp~14:30. No new ordinary travel random encounter roll because this is active quest-specific pursuit of fixed detachment along its established trail, not a separate ordinary journey. Source fixed packet dm-hollow-pennant.md @ba86b23cb89d85846bb0ae8652d31cf47fd2e4d6. Camp is rectangular timber palisade100x80ft, west gate(0,0), central clearing(40,0), stores/tent(70,20), captain area(70,-20), watch perch(40,40,z15), dry culvert(70,-40) hidden until investigated. V/C/F stop behind intervening woodland/outcrop approx(-150,0) west of gate before stepping into exposed sightline; no stealth check adjudicated or guaranteed undetected beyond cover; camp has not visibly reacted to their presence. P1–P4 have returned alive/full HP to actual clearing near own bedrolls; P1 reports the interruption/claimed titled investigator and that no supplies obtained to P5 Knight captain. Captain orders existing watch maintained; no additional troops, departure, supply procurement, confirmed hostile action, distant report or final attack clock, since no supplies arrived. P5 at captain/tent area, P6 Scout on perch, P7 Guard at west gate, P8 Guard stores; actual total eight fighters now in camp, no double count. From approach, party sees timber palisade, west gate guard and elevated lookout, foot tracks entering gate, glimpses movement inside but cannot count/identify all eight through timber walls or see hidden culvert/porters without further recon. Fixed eight-fighter composition and defenses retained (P1 Veteran HP58 AC17, P2/P3/P6 Scouts HP16 AC13, P4/P7/P8 Guards HP11 AC16, P5 Knight standard2014 HP52 AC18), two coerced adult porters in work shelter(50,-20) not yet revealed; depot9, command7, quartermaster/controller unchanged. Cirren notes they have found where the men actually returned, not yet the toll-fort. No new attack, initiative, civilian injury, field evidence seizure, commission milestone, payment, political claim or knowledge of sponsor. D356 daily supply charge remains pending (party separated but same total three eaters/four horses, no duplicate consumption); resources all unchanged. V next decision how to reconnoiter, approach, bypass, or return.
